SELECT coalesce(nullif(concat_ws(' + ',
  CASE WHEN rgn4_sel_extclk = 1 THEN 'External' END,
  CASE WHEN rgn4_sel_clk10m = 1 THEN '10 MHz' END,
  CASE WHEN rgn4_sel_clk1m = 1 THEN '1 MHz' END,
  CASE WHEN rgn4_sel_clk100k = 1 THEN '100 kHz' END,
  CASE WHEN rgn4_sel_clk10k = 1 THEN '10 kHz' END,
  CASE WHEN rgn4_sel_clk1k = 1 THEN '1 kHz' END,
  CASE WHEN rgn4_sel_rsv2 = 1 THEN 'Reserve2' END), ''), 'none') AS clock
FROM trigger ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: RGN4 spill gate (0: Off, 1: Spill On, 2: Spill Off, 3: OR).

panels.title: Clock gate

panels.description: RGN1 SEL_TOF segment selector (TOF_SEG1-24 in the param file; bit i = segment i+1), currently used for BH2. Raw register value in parentheses.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN count(i) = 0 THEN 'none'
  WHEN count(i) = max(i) - min(i) + 1 THEN format('seg %s–%s', min(i) + 1, max(i) + 1)
  ELSE 'seg ' || string_agg((i + 1)::text, ',' ORDER BY i) END || format(' (%s)', max(v)) AS sel
FROM (SELECT rgn1_sel_tof AS v FROM trigger ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) r
LEFT JOIN generate_series(0, 23) i ON (r.v >> i) & 1 = 1

panels.title: Selector (BH2)

panels.description: module/trigger.py writes when the setting changes and at least once an hour. Orange > 1.5 h, red > 3 h (module stopped?).

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - timestamp) FROM trigger ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Trigger data age

panels.description: From hul-trig-ctrl last.log. Condition: × = coincidence, / = veto. Prescale = RGN3 PS register + 1. PS-OR = trigger included in the prescaled OR (RGN3 SEL_PSOR bit). Gate = spill gate (0: Off, 1: Spill On, 2: Spill Off, 3: OR), as in hul-trig-ctrl param files.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.name AS "Trigger",
  regexp_replace(t.cond, 'x', ' × ', 'g') AS "Condition",
  t.ps + 1 AS "Prescale",
  (r.rgn3_sel_psor >> t.i) & 1 AS "PS-OR",
  t.gate AS "Gate"
FROM (SELECT * FROM trigger ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) r,
LATERAL (VALUES
  ('A', r.trig_a, r.rgn3_ps_r2a, 0, r.rgn3_gate_r2a), ('B', r.trig_b, r.rgn3_ps_r2b, 1, r.rgn3_gate_r2b),
  ('C', r.trig_c, r.rgn3_ps_r2c, 2, r.rgn3_gate_r2c), ('D', r.trig_d, r.rgn3_ps_r2d, 3, r.rgn3_gate_r2d),
  ('E', r.trig_e, r.rgn3_ps_r2e, 4, r.rgn3_gate_r2e), ('F', r.trig_f, r.rgn3_ps_r2f, 5, r.rgn3_gate_r2f)
) AS t(name, cond, ps, i, gate)
ORDER BY t.name

targets.rawSql:
SELECT h.run_number AS "Run",
  CASE WHEN h.stop_time IS NULL THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'stopped' END AS "Status",
  h.start_time AS "Start", h.stop_time AS "Stop",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM coalesce(h.stop_time, now()) - h.start_time) AS "Duration",
  h.recorder::int AS "Recorder", h.event_number AS "Events", h.data_size_bytes AS "Size",
  CASE WHEN NOT h.recorder OR h.stop_time IS NULL OR NOT h.data_size_bytes > 0 THEN ''
       WHEN k.size_bytes = h.data_size_bytes THEN 'done'
       WHEN k.run_number IS NOT NULL THEN 'partial'
       ELSE 'pending' END AS "KEKCC",
  h.comment AS "Comment"
FROM hddaq h LEFT JOIN kekcc_rawdata k USING (run_number)
ORDER BY h.run_number DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.description: Every run in hddaq, newest first. Use the column filters to search.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT run_number AS "Run",
  CASE WHEN stop_time IS NULL THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'stopped' END AS "Status",
  start_time AS "Start", stop_time AS "Stop",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM coalesce(stop_time, now()) - start_time) AS "Duration",
  recorder::int AS "Recorder", event_number AS "Events", data_size_bytes AS "Size",
  comment AS "Comment"
FROM hddaq
ORDER BY run_number DESC
